company.name: Grip
company.shortDescription: Grip is a market engagement platform used by event organizers to create virtual and live event experiences.
company.description:
Grip is a market engagement platform used by conferences, trade shows, and corporate event organizers to empower professionals to achieve their business goals. 

Used by 13 out of 20 event organizers for both virtual and in-person events, Grip has more than 50 team members spread across Europe and the US.

The company was founded in 2014 by Brent Hoberman and Tim Groot and is based in London.

productsAndServices.description: An event engagement platform for networking, matchmaking, meeting management, personalized schedules, content access, and participant interaction at in-person, virtual, and hybrid events.
productsAndServices.name: Grip Engage

productsAndServices.description: A branded web and mobile event app that provides event schedules, attendee networking, AI recommendations, meeting management, exhibitor directories, lead retrieval, floor plans, notifications, and content access.
productsAndServices.name: Grip Event App

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered matchmaking and networking solution that recommends relevant participants, exhibitors, sponsors, sessions, and meeting opportunities based on profiles, preferences, behavior, and event objectives.
productsAndServices.name: Grip Event Matchmaking

productsAndServices.description: A meeting scheduling solution for arranging curated one-to-one and group meetings between buyers, suppliers, exhibitors, sponsors, investors, and other event participants.
productsAndServices.name: Grip Pre-Scheduled Meetings

productsAndServices.description: An event management system for registration, sponsor and exhibitor administration, side events, speakers, sessions, and submissions, with integrations for existing event technology stacks.
productsAndServices.name: Grip Manage

productsAndServices.description: A set of onsite event tools for badge printing, entrance scanning, access control, smart exchange of participant information, and location tracking.
productsAndServices.name: Grip Onsite
